## Who we are

The [Wasatch Front Regional Council](https://wfrc.utah.gov/){target="_blank"} (WFRC) is the Metropolitan Planning Organization for the Salt Lake and Ogden-Layton urban areas. It serves six counties: Box Elder, Davis, Morgan, Salt Lake, Tooele and Weber.

WFRC's mission is to *build consensus and enhance quality of life by developing and implementing visions and plans for a well-functioning multi-modal transportation system, livable communities, a strong economy, and a healthy environment.*

The Analytics team builds the data, models and tools that give those plans a quantitative foundation.

## How we work

- **In the open.** Most of our work lives in public repositories on [GitHub](https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics){target="_blank"}. Repositories that need WFRC access are marked **Internal** on this site.
- **Reproducibly.** Model runs and calibration are tied to specific model versions, so results can be traced and repeated.
- **With standard tools.** Python, R, Quarto and web mapping libraries, plus Cube Voyager for travel demand modeling and UrbanSim for real-estate market modeling.

## Partners and data sources

Our work depends on partners and data from the Mountainland Association of Governments (MAG), the Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT), the Utah Transit Authority (UTA), the Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute at the University of Utah, the Utah Department of Workforce Services, the Utah Geospatial Resource Center, and the U.S. Census Bureau.
